summary: Writes a fixed-format binary block through FileWriteWithBackendDispatch: a length byte a2 is used as the payload length, a header byte 1, then a2 bytes copied from this+1, the payload is null-terminated at this[a2+1], and three trailing fixed-size regions at this+65 (32), this+97 (32), and this+132 (4) plus a final 4-byte region at this+136 are flushed. Always returns 1.

operations.description: Write 1 byte from this (a header byte) via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Write 1 byte from the length variable a2 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Write a2 bytes from this+1 (the payload) via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Write 32 bytes from this+65 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Write 32 bytes from this+97 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Write 4 bytes from this+132 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.
Write 4 bytes from this+136 via FileWriteWithBackendDispatch.

unresolved: Semantics of the on-disk block: fields at +65/+97 (32 bytes each) and +132/+136 (4 bytes each) are unnamed.
Meaning of the length byte a2 and how this block is consumed by the ModelSceneFileLoader caller.
Which backend FileWriteWithBackendDispatch selects is not resolvable from this function alone.
